reference.type: scanned PDF board book (raster only, logos)
reference.notes: deck_class raster: palette, ink, chrome, margins and line pitch from pixels; faces named by eye; the reference's variety is no evidence; the judge cannot judge.

brief: Five-page credentials section for a sell-side pitch to a telecom equipment company: why us, league table, selected deals, team, buyer universe.

expected_behavior.statement: Every page of the delivered deck is status fit and the package validates.
expected_behavior.check: deck.build.json: every slides[].status == 'fit'; validation_ok == true; `pptx_tools.py validate --render` ok.

expected_behavior.statement: plan.py check passes on the plan the deck was built with, and the build ran with --plan.
Every figure stated in a title, lead-in or callout is computed from the page's own data.
expected_behavior.check: For each stated figure, recompute it from the brief's data; zero mismatches. The agent's figure-check script is present and passes.

expected_behavior.statement: chart_defaults_taken is empty or every remaining entry is named in the report as intended.
The agent looked at every render and wrote located findings (element id, what, the change), and stayed within the build cap.
expected_behavior.check: Transcript: one findings list per review round; builds <= 8 per 5 pages; the delivered build is the best kept, not merely the last.

expected_behavior.statement: The final report separates measured, completed-by-judgement and substituted values, and lists what the user must supply.
The agent ran raster_style.py, applied its patch, and named the faces by eye with the evidence.
expected_behavior.check: guide provenance raster_inference; the report names the faces and why.

expected_behavior.statement: With no variety evidence in the reference, the plan is held to the corpus's longest run (plan.CORPUS_LONGEST_RUN, 2): no undeclared run longer than that, and every repeat it warns about is answered.
expected_behavior.check: plan.check.json: no refusal; each repeats[] entry's held_to basis names the corpus; each warning answered in the plan or the report.

expected_behavior.statement: The style verdict is given from the renders side by side, not from a judge number.
expected_behavior.check: judge.cannot_judge present; the report's verdict cites the renders.

expected_behavior.statement: Logos the reference shows are carried and placed, or the report asks the user for them.
